scope: Six named review groups for Fresno County and its boundary river reaches. These are not catchments, predicted inundation boundaries or staging sites.
associationBasis: Explicit grouping of the existing NWPS and CDEC watchlists by named river reach. Gauge and dam coordinates are publisher locations in EPSG:4326. Operator confirmation of downstream routing and local action thresholds is pending.

areas.name: San Joaquin · Friant to Mendota
areas.note: Friant river outlet and spill are upstream context for this boundary reach. Diversions, intervening controls and travel time are not modeled. Millerton total outflow is excluded from river-release cues.

areas.name: San Joaquin · Redinger reach
areas.note: Upstream of Millerton. Friant releases are not assigned to this reach; no Redinger release feed is connected.

areas.name: Little Dry Creek · below Friant
areas.note: Tributary watchpoint. Friant Dam releases are not treated as releases into Little Dry Creek.

areas.name: James Bypass
areas.note: Bypass operations and connectivity require operator confirmation. No reservoir release is automatically routed to this area.

areas.name: Kings · Trimmer & North Fork
areas.note: Upstream Kings River context. Pine Flat releases are not assigned to these upstream gauges.

areas.name: Kings · below Pine Flat
areas.note: Pine Flat reported outflow provides release context. No downstream Kings gauge is connected in this pilot. Upstream gauges are not substituted; downstream routing and distributary operations remain unverified.
